title: Luke Skywalker
description: After rescuing The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, and his allies from Moff Gideon's Dark Troopers, Luke Skywalker took Grogu with him to train the child in the ways of the Force. While Grogu made progress, Luke feared that his continued attachment to the Mandalorian would be a problem. He offered Grogu the choice between remaining with him to became a Jedi, or returning to The Mandalorian. Grogu chose The Mandalorian.
